answers.reason: The student holds no office and does not decide university-wide statutes and strategy.
The student holds no office and is not responsible for the university budget.
The student holds no office and is not involved in hiring professors.
The student holds no office, whereas the elected student representative speaks for students in formal faculty bodies.
The student holds no office, and student representation in formal committees is handled by the elected student representative.
The examination board decides on the matters of individual students, or the student has no formal office to sit on the board.
The student is enrolled in a bachelor programme and does not conduct faculty research projects.
The student holds no office and is not responsible for writing module descriptions.
The student holds no office and is not responsible for purchasing laboratory equipment.
Every member has one place where their matters are decided, and planning the orientation week for new students is the working round where an ordinary student takes part.
